Bihar BJP Leaders Donate Salary for Flood Relief

Leaders from Bihar's Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) have contributed to flood relief efforts in the state. National President Nitin Nabin donated three months of his salary. The Bihar BJP unit collectively contributed Rs 51 lakh towards relief work. The specific details of the flood's impact or the total relief amount being sought were not detailed in the coverage.
